messages:
Elena: Hey team — prep request for "Serving Wins" webinar promo + benchmark assets. Need a compact bundle for launch day: 1) keynote hero slide (1920x1080, layered figma), 2) benchmark chart (cost vs latency) optimized for social, 3) editable slide master with header/footer and logo lockups, 4) three social versions (square, story, wide), 5) email header (600x200), 6) SDR one-pager PDF (print-friendly) + single-page HTML version for reps. Also: export PNG/SVG for engineering and add accessible alt text for each visual. Deadline: first comps by Tue EOD so we can iterate Wed. @Ravi @Maya
Ravi: noted. A few clarifying Qs: will benchmark chart show multiple model variants or just Redwood baseline vs competitor average? also need raw CSV and preferred color tokens.
Elena: show Redwood baseline, two competitor clusters (avg), and a 'recommended config' callout. CSV is in the analytics sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE_ANALYTICS — granting view to design. Use brand colors but keep high contrast for small screens.
Maya: brand rules: use Redwood Blue (#0B3D91) for primary line, Ink (#111219) for labels. No gradients for the chart. Icons should be from the Brand icon set (outline style). I'll add color swatches in the figma file and paste accessible contrast pairs.
Owen: copy options for hero (short / punchy):
- Option 1: "Ship LLM features faster. Spend less per token."
- Option 2: "High-performance inference that scales — lower cost, predictable latency."
- Option 3: "Serve smarter: speed, savings, and reliability."
Use Option 2 for hero, variants for social CTAs.
Theo: inbound routing — please use UTMs and HubSpot field mapping below. We'll set the lifecycle stage to "Lead" then MQL when lead_score >= 50 and webinar_attended = true.
```
utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_wins_launch

HubSpot mapping:
- hs_lead_source => "Webinar: Serving Wins"
- hs_campaign => "serving_wins_launch"
- hs_tags => "webinar_servingwins"
```
Elena: legal check required on any percentage or comparative claims. @LegalBot can you review the numbers source and caption?
LegalBot: attaching checklist — need API run logs or CSV provenance. No superlatives without source note. Will review by Tue noon.
Ravi: designer notes: will produce 3 comp directions for the hero (typography-led, photo + overlay, clean data focus). I'll put the benchmark chart in three sizes and a simplified thumbnail for social previews. ETA: first exports Tue 6pm.
Elena: perfect. Please name files using this convention: servingwins_<asset>_<size>_<ver>.png (e.g., servingwins_hero_1920x1080_v1.png). Add alt text in Figma description.
Maya: add brand-safe margin notes for logo usage: stacked lockup on hero, horizontal on one-pager footer. Min clearspace = 1x logo height. No color swaps unless approved.
Ravi: will include caption under chart: "Per-token cost vs median latency — lower is better. Source: internal benchmark runs."
Owen: add a short footnote copy: "Data from internal tests and open-source model evaluations; see full methodology in the linked doc."
Elena: linking methodology doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE_METHOD. Please tag the sheet row "approved_for_publish" after Legal signs off.
Theo: I'll provision the HubSpot form and share embed + hidden fields for UTMs. Also adding tracking for session_id to tie attendees to demo follow-ups.
figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/SERVING_WINS - shared with participants. Prototype pages: Hero, Benchmark, Socials, OnePager.
Ravi: will attach export checklist (PNG @ 2x for social, SVG for web, PDF for print) and include alt-text snippets in the description.
Elena: great — thanks all. I'll coordinate review loop: Design -> Brand -> Legal -> Ops. Ping me when comps are up. :rocket:
notes: Kickoff thread for webinar asset production, benchmark diagram, export naming, UTMs, HubSpot mapping, legal review, and Figma collaboration.
